candidates.quote: Backed by an onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin GPU, the X10 harnesses unrivaled computing power to make the right decisions in real-time.
Equipped with the NVIDIA Jetson Orin SoC as the main processor, the Skydio X10 achieves a computing processing performance that is more than 10 times that of previous Skydio drone models.

raw_candidates.quote: Backed by an onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin GPU, the X10 harnesses unrivaled computing power to make the right decisions in real-time.
Equipped with the NVIDIA Jetson Orin SoC as the main processor, the Skydio X10 achieves a computing processing performance that is more than 10 times that of previous Skydio drone models.

attempts.notes: Skydio's own X10 page and a Nidec (motor supplier) release both confirm the NVIDIA Jetson Orin SoC as the X10's main processor, running autonomy/flight compute; NVIDIA is US-HQ'd with no stated chip manufacturing country. Tier-2 was harder: TechPowerUp and topcpu pages were blocked, so I relied on a die-shot database and a chip-spec site stating the Orin die is fabricated by Samsung on its 8nm process. No FCC teardown of the X10 confirming board-level chip layout was found.
